scope: Full review of both synchronization canonicals, all 54 retained source blocks, 24 documentary clauses plus 2 U requirements, all 36 finite case actions and the future fixture, source/parser pins and snapshots. Approval is limited to this partial analyst documentary draft, without protocol, exact-target compatibility or family-completion approval.

checks.independent_additional_checks: Verified the supplied manifest seal, all payload and external pin sizes/hashes, source metadata identity, source text-index reproduction, source-role/requirement equality, 24D12/2U counts, null outcomes, fixture references, canonical links/anchors/metadata and git diff --no-index --check against /dev/null for untracked text files. The frozen manifest and all payload hashes still match after validation.

semantic_evidence.assessment: Network membership/count, initial/peer tempo roles, independent transport, stopped progress and optional shared start/stop match source prose. The last-change statement supplies no distributed causal ordering. External input tempo is retained without conflict arbitration. No phase, scheduler, grid, clock-convergence or timing equation is imported from finite clip/playback contracts. Count alone is explicitly insufficient synchronization proof.

Settings, visibility, names, capability prerequisites, peer/source selectors and status/buffer display follow the retained text. Link Audio existence in exact12.4.3 remains explicitly U. Latency and Sync to Incoming Audio remain public source roles, without private buffer structure or numeric delay oracle. Only-one-participant wording is preserved as documentary guidance; no multiple-enabled failure/enforcement policy is invented. Recording monitor/arm gates and general routing are linked to their owners.

Configured audio input, visible Follow, hidden-feature nonoperation, unavailable-channel gray state and Follower/EXT exclusion match the source. Clear-rhythm optimization is not an input rejection law. Outgoing MIDI clock is distinguished from incoming clock while Follower is active. No detector, tempo range, acquisition deadline or tracking-error threshold follows.

MIDI Clock sender/receiver and MTC receiver-only roles are correctly separated. MTC position does not establish meter or tempo tracking. Upper/lower indicator roles match the prose but do not prove peer synchronization, valid protocol grammar or timing. Song-position loop wrapping remains prose with no modulus/origin/scheduling formula.

Per-device rate/offset applicability, SMPTE All, separate Arrangement display format, SMPTE offset role and Sync Delay listening guidance match the retained text. No SMPTE rate enumeration, drop-frame conversion, input grammar, numeric sign/range/tolerance or calibration is guessed. Link-enabled recording count-in is a new synchronization predicate on the existing Recording owner, not a redefinition of count-in or ordinary metronome playback.

Protocol/numerical, malformed/boundary/detector/peer/audio/MTC and undo/cancel/persistence/loss/arbitration/teardown proposals remain explicitly U with null documentary and target expectations. Cases require connected usable sources, active nonzero output and independently established positive baselines; unavailable features/peers/input/permissions remain inconclusive. No future fixture is reported as measured evidence.

nonblocking_gaps: Current Version12 prose has no immutable exact12.4.3 publication identity; even Link Audio feature presence in that target remains unknown.

Future fixtures provide no actual peers, media, MIDI messages, validated rate list, captures or reference/candidate results. Each applicable positive path must be independently established before execution.
Compound clauses and category probes need concrete per-branch stimuli, accepted interface values and captured control/platform contexts before becoming runnable acceptance tests.

All protocol, clock/detector/position/latency arithmetic, jitter/convergence limits, peer interoperability, failure arbitration, persistence and recovery results remain unresolved. Count/name/status/LED and listening guidance alone cannot close them.
Broader automation, resource-limit and stopped/active sample-rate lifecycle coverage is not complete; the partial U catalog does not close these families.
